How to Launch FireFly

Follow the instructions below to set up and launch FireFly using an online HTML compiler.

---

Step 1: Open an Online HTML Compiler

Go to one of the following unblocked HTML compilers:

* [OnlineGDB HTML Compiler](https://www.onlinegdb.com/online_html_compiler)
* [Great Learning HTML Editor](https://www.mygreatlearning.com/blog/html-editor-tool/)
* [Tutorialspoint Online HTML Editor](https://www.tutorialspoint.com/compilers/online-html-editor.htm)
* [GeeksforGeeks Online HTML Editor](https://ide.geeksforgeeks.org/online-html-editor)

> **Note:** If none of the links above work on your network, search for `"html online compiler"` in your web browser.

---

Step 2: Copy and Paste the HTML Code

Copy the HTML code below and paste it into the editor's HTML tab (usually named `index.html`):

<!DOCTYPE html> <html> <head> <title>dud</title> <style> html, body { margin: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; } #game { width: 100%; height: 100%; border: none; } </style> </head> <body> <iframe id="game"></iframe> <script> const html = atob(""); const iframe = document.getElementById("game"); iframe.srcdoc = html; </script> </body> </html>
